outcome.stat_test: One-factor ANOVA with Tukey's HSD at alpha=5% (per data set in Table IV); two-sample t-tests RUSBoost vs SMOTEBoost only (Table VII)

win_claim.quote: RUSBoost and SMOTEBoost both outperform the other procedures, and RUSBoost performs comparably to (and often better than) SMOTEBoost while being a simpler and faster technique.
